bounded_claim: Determine whether the source-faithful 16 ordered terrain/operator channel cycle has a unique perturbation-stable global attractor for each chirality type, and whether that basin is distinctive rather than a generic consequence of installing dissipation.
claim_ceiling: A pass may establish a real attractor for the explicitly installed finite CPTP cycle and characterize its depth and perspectives. It cannot establish that the cycle, basin, 16 stages, four substages, engine types, Axis0, perception, objects, MMMs, ontologies, or mesh utility are forced or canonical.
blocked_consumers: MMM, ontology, mesh, business, or physics claims
stage movement, formal admission, or canonical promotion

carrier.state_space: 2x2 density matrices represented by Bloch vectors in the closed unit ball
carrier.terrain_maps: finite-time Lindblad CPTP channels from the committed Se/Ne/Ni/Si collapse operators with Type1 H=+H0 and Type2 H=-H0 plus mirrored collapse operators
carrier.axis6_rule: operator-first versus terrain-first is composition precedence only and never creates a new operator formula

perspectives: Liouville superoperator spectrum and fixed-point multiplicity
Bloch-ball contraction and trace-distance basin depth
Umegaki relative entropy to the fixed point
Bures distance to the fixed point

preregistered_tests.T1_unique_full_rank_fixed_point: exactly one eigenvalue is within 1e-9 of 1 and fixed-state minimum eigenvalue exceeds 1e-9
preregistered_tests.T2_strict_transverse_contraction: subdominant superoperator eigenvalue modulus is below 1-1e-8
preregistered_tests.T3_global_sampled_convergence: maximum trace distance across 1024 initial states at horizon 256 is below 1e-8
preregistered_tests.T4_relative_entropy_pawl: U(rho_t||rho_star) has no increase above 1e-9 on any sampled trajectory
preregistered_tests.T5_depth_matches_spectral_prediction: observed epsilon-depth and spectral mixing prediction agree within a factor of 4
preregistered_tests.T6_parameter_robustness: all 0.9/1.0/1.1 parameter multipliers retain T1-T4 and fixed-point drift stays below 0.2 trace distance
preregistered_tests.T7_basis_covariance: conjugating every map and initial/fixed state by each Pauli basis transform preserves spectra and distance trajectories to 1e-9
preregistered_tests.T8_schedule_sensitivity: schedule controls are reported as an atlas; no pass is assigned merely for changing or preserving the fixed point
preregistered_tests.T9_genericity_kill_control: compare matched random primitive CPTP cycles; theory-specificity requires the native contraction gap to exceed the 95th percentile of controls
preregistered_tests.T10_unitary_no-attraction_control: erasing every dissipative component must destroy strict attraction
preregistered_tests.T11_commuting_fixed_manifold_control: a commuting dephasing-only cycle must retain a non-unique fixed-point manifold
preregistered_tests.T12_type_difference: Type1 and Type2 fixed points or depth profiles must differ above 1e-6 to count as different installed dynamics

verdict_rule.REAL_DISTINCTIVE_INSTALLED_BASINS: T1-T7, T9-T12 pass for both types
verdict_rule.REAL_BUT_GENERIC_INSTALLED_BASINS: T1-T7 and T10-T12 pass for both types while T9 fails
verdict_rule.LOCAL_OR_FRAGILE_INSTALLED_BASIN_ONLY: nominal T1-T4 pass but robustness or controls fail
verdict_rule.NO_REAL_ATTRACTOR_BASIN_IN_THIS_MAP: nominal T1, T2, T3, or T4 fails
